answer: Only an identity perched on one ledge earns weight: a minimum stake held unbroken across consecutive epochs. Splitting that stake across n clones pushes every clone off the ledge, so each earns zero instead of a share, and a violet mark tags any identity caught re-entering with a fragment of a split stake, voiding its weight for the epoch. Trying to ripple one honest stake across many heads therefore costs a full climb per head while yielding nothing, while a single whole identity keeps compounding.
